resources.string: Chinese Pinyin dictionary
Hanzi characters and phrases from CC-CEDICT, 120,000 entries. The keyboard needs this pack for Chinese conversion.
Japanese kana to kanji dictionary
Kana readings from mozc, 1.08 million entries, about 42 MB. The keyboard needs this pack for Japanese conversion.
Chinese word pairs
Which words follow which, counted from Chinese web and news text. Comes with the Pinyin dictionary. With it, initials like wbxh give 我不喜欢 first and not two unrelated words.
Chinese stroke (笔画) dictionary
A table of stroke order to Hanzi characters. The keyboard needs this pack for the stroke layout.
Hanja (漢字) dictionary
Hangul words and their Hanja, 300,000 entries. The keyboard needs this pack to offer Hanja on the suggestion strip.
Cangjie (倉頡) dictionary
A table of radical codes to Hanzi characters, 29,000 characters. The keyboard needs this pack for the Cangjie and Quick layouts.
Traditional characters phrase table
Phrases from OpenCC, 50,000 entries, about 1 MB. With Traditional characters on, the keyboard uses it to write the correct form for the word, such as 頭髮 and not 頭發.
Cantonese Jyutping dictionary
A table of Jyutping readings to Hanzi characters, 163,000 entries. The keyboard needs this pack for Cantonese conversion.
RIME essentials
Punctuation, symbols, the word-frequency table and the Simplified and Traditional conversion every RIME schema uses. Downloaded with the first schema.
Luna Pinyin (朙月拼音)
RIME\'s own Pinyin schema, with the stroke schema it looks characters up by.
Rime Ice (雾凇拼音)
A large modern Simplified Chinese vocabulary for Pinyin, with Double Pinyin and 9-key variants. Compiling it takes a minute or more.
Bopomofo (注音)
RIME\'s Zhuyin schema on the standard Dachen key map, with Terra Pinyin\'s dictionary.
Cangjie 5 (倉頡五代)
RIME\'s fifth-generation Cangjie schema, characters and phrases.
Jyutping (粵拼)
The rime-cantonese schema for Cantonese, with its word and phrase lists.
Mozc dictionary
Mozc\'s own system dictionary, with its connection costs, segmenter and suggestion filter. The Mozc engine converts with this; the built-in engine does not use it.
Japanese handwriting model
Simplified Chinese handwriting model
Traditional Chinese handwriting model
The Tegaki project\'s model for zinnia, the offline handwriting recogniser that reads Chinese and Japanese where ML Kit\'s does not.
